archetypes.name: sentinel-state-machine
archetypes.rationale: The plan rewires pause/resume sentinel ownership across many step boundaries, making state-machine regressions the highest-value dynamic review target.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace the proposed sentinel host moves against the existing design step flow, pause/resume ordering, and out-of-sequence assumptions. Look for missing marker writes, stale-marker clears, route-specific gaps, or places where folded writes would make resume skip or replay the wrong step. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: harness-fidelity
archetypes.rationale: The plan depends heavily on structure tests matching real shell writes instead of prose, so the test harness itself needs targeted plan review.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether the proposed test-harness changes can actually prove the intended shell-fence contracts rather than matching comments, prose, or the wrong fenced block. Check fence extraction, ordering assertions, negative guards, and route-specific fixture coverage against the planned SKILL.md edits. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: contract-drift
archetypes.rationale: The change spans SKILL.md, scripts, script docs, and configuration docs, creating risk that documented contracts diverge from runtime and test behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the proposed edits across runtime prompt text, helper scripts, test documentation, and configuration documentation for inconsistent contracts. Focus on pause-load semantics, Gate C chat ordering, SIMPLE versus HARD marker hosts, architecture-diagram skip handling, and documented exceptions such as Step 6 cleanup. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
